summary: Occupying a generous plot with a large rear garden, this exceptional four-bedroom Victorian home is arranged over three spacious floors and offers an outstanding blend of period charm and modern family living. The ground floor features an elegant living room, a stunning kitchen with an exposed brick chimney breast and log burner, utility room, and a bright orangery overlooking the garden. The versatile lower ground floor provides annexe potential with a second reception room, double bedroom and wet room. Upstairs are three generous bedrooms and a stylish four-piece family bathroom. Outside, the enclosed rear garden offers a patio, lawn and private off-road parking. Homes of this size, character and flexibility rarely come to the market, making this a superb opportunity for families and those seeking versatile accommodation.
description: An Exceptional Victorian Family Home with Versatile Accommodation, Large Garden, Private Parking & Period Charm Occupying a generous plot and arranged over three spacious floors, this beautifully presented four-bedroom Victorian residence effortlessly combines timeless period character with the practicality of modern family living. Offering over three levels of flexible accommodation, private rear parking, and a wealth of original features, homes of this calibre are rarely available. Stepping through the front door, you are welcomed by a spacious entrance hallway that immediately sets the tone for the impressive accommodation beyond. The elegant front living room provides a relaxing retreat, while the heart of the home is undoubtedly the stunning kitchen, where a striking exposed brick chimney breast and feature log burner create a warm and inviting focal point. The kitchen flows seamlessly into a useful utility room, providing additional storage and practicality for everyday living. To the rear of the property, the orangery offers a wonderful additional reception space, flooded with natural light and enjoying views across the large rear garden. French doors open onto a beautifully enclosed garden featuring a generous patio ideal for entertaining, a lawned area perfect for families, and the added luxury of private off-road parking accessed via the rear—an increasingly rare feature for a property of this era. The lower ground floor provides outstanding versatility and is perfectly suited for multi-generational living, guest accommodation or those seeking to create a self-contained annexe. Comprising a spacious second reception room, a generous double bedroom and a modern wet room, this level offers endless possibilities to suit a variety of lifestyles. The upper floor continues to impress with three well-proportioned double bedrooms, all offering generous accommodation and an abundance of natural light. These are complemented by a stylish family bathroom fitted with a contemporary four-piece suite, including both a separate bath and walk-in shower. Properties of this quality, size and character seldom come to the market. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate everything this exceptional home has to offer.
